svg.title: Hook Cam — Component Specification
svg.desc: Hook Cam system concept sheet. Editable SVG text with preserved TRACI and Embuilded logo artwork.
svg.text: Confirmed vendor data separated from target requirements and items awaiting selection
3 TOPS NPU; INT8 / INT16 mixed compute
16 GB eMMC; microSD up to 512 GB
Dual electret microphones; 8 Ω / 1 W speaker
USB-C OTG; debug UART; CAN ×2; GPIO ×2
PoE; 12–24 V DC barrel; 7.4 V battery management
UART, I²C and I/O; 3.3 V LVTTL
Industrial LTE; Ethernet; VPN; watchdog preferred
Confirm injector/switch and camera PoE standard
Confirm voltage, SPL, current and duty cycle
Isolated driver matched to siren load
Define IP rating and temperature range
Confirm radio and site certification needs
1. Confirm whether reCamera is powered directly from 12–24 V DC or through a dedicated PoE injector.
2. Select the 4G router before finalising average power, Ethernet topology, VPN and remote-access behaviour.
3. Confirm TF02-Pro mounting angle, measurement target and whether UART or I²C is used.
4. Select siren voltage and SPL, then specify the isolated relay/driver and alarm duty cycle.
5. Freeze enclosure, connector, battery swap and site environmental requirements before detailed engineering.
DRAFT — component selection and wiring subject to engineering validation
